benchmark_source.source: Fitch: institutional govt MMF net yield 3.45%, prime 3.59% at 30-Jun-2026; Fed funds 3.50-3.75% held all 2026 (cranedata.com)

project_mc_basis.exit_multiple_sd: 0.15: terminal value is the dominant share of equity value; Dubai prices moved +60% 2022-Q1-25 and -5..-15% since end-2025 (S&P via truhauz)
project_mc_basis.fx: AED/USD peg; 0.3%/yr prob of 20% step - tail only, benchmark is USD. L
project_mc_basis.ramp_delay_prob: 0.35: Q1-2026 only ~43% of scheduled Dubai units delivered (Cavendish Maxwell); delay modelled as a zero-rent first year with mortgage already drawn (conservative)
project_mc_basis.tenant_default_prob: 0.10 over 7y, single tenant = 100% of revenue, 1-year re-let (annual granularity overstates a 2-4 month void; offsets non-payment/legal time). L

capex.source: User: price AED 3.1M, orig 2.6M, 40% paid, 60% at handover Q4-2027 -> t0 = 1.04M paid-up + 0.5M premium + DLD 4% (124k) + DLD admin 4.2k (L) + agency 2%+VAT (65.1k) + dev NOC 5.25k (L); t1 = 1.56M handover + bank fee 1%+VAT, mortgage reg 0.25%+290, valuation 3.15k, fit-out/snagging 15k (L)

debt_draw_year.source: Mortgage drawn at handover (t=1) to fund 60% payment

debt_pct.source: User: 50% LTV on AED 3.1M = AED 1.55M at handover, expressed as share of total capex

debt_rate.source: User ~4.6%; market: resident fixed 3.75-4.19%, off-plan 3y fixed 4.24%, variable 3M EIBOR+0.70-1.49% (huspy.com, 2026)

debt_tenor.source: Assumption: 25-year annuity, balance repaid at exit (balloon)

discount_rate.source: Gate equity IRR hurdle 12% (config/gate_thresholds.json, AE uplift 0)

fixed_opex.source: User: service charge AED 22/sqft x 1,250 = 27,500 (vs community avg AED 16/sqft, range 13-22, realestateclubdubai Feb-2026) + maintenance 5,000 + insurance 1,500 (L)

operating_years.source: User: hold 7 years; read as 7 years after handover (exit ~Q4 2034). 6y variant in scenarios

ramp.source: Assume let from first operating year; vacancy in revenue_y1

revenue_escalation.source: Assumption: 1.5% p.a.; 146k units scheduled 2027 (Cavendish Maxwell via realestateclubdubai, Jul-2026) caps rent growth

revenue_y1.source: Comps: Bayut 2BR Dubai Hills avg ask AED 159.6k, DLD Ejari avg 151.5k (bayut.com, Oct-2026); new-build ~1,250-1,290 sqft comps 160-175k (The Grove 1,282 sqft 175k; Golf Grand ~1,150 sqft 155-160k). Base gross 175k x (1-5% vacancy). User expects 190k (sponsor case).

tax_rate.source: UAE: no personal income tax on rental income (individual holder)

terminal_multiple_ebitda.source: Exit cap 4.75% on NOI = comps net yield ~4.5% (gross 6.0-6.3% Bayut/DLD H1-2026 via truhauz.com, less ~1.5-2.5pt costs per mirihomes.com) +25bp drift (supply, building age); x(1-2% selling costs)

sponsor_claims.note: user expectation, no IRR claimed; seller's original price 2.6M

name: Dubai Hills 2BR off-plan resale
sizing: Pay ≤ AED 2.60M to match the money-market fund; ≤ AED 2.32M to beat it by 3 pts (asking 3.1M).
thesis: Only works if same-building achieved rents reach ≥ AED 221k at the 2027 handover peak.
